definitions.explanation: A woman married to one's father who is not one's biological mother.

examples.japanese: {義母|ぎぼ}と{同居|どうきょ}している。
{義母|ぎぼ}は{料理|りょうり}が{上手|じょうず}だ。
examples.english: My mother-in-law is good at cooking.

examples.japanese: {義母|ぎぼ}との{関係|かんけい}は{良好|りょうこう}です。
examples.english: My relationship with my mother-in-law is good.

notes:
TERMS OF ADDRESS:
While {義母|ぎぼ} is the formal/written term, in conversation people typically address their mother-in-law as:
・お{義母|かあ}さん - most common
・{義|ぎ}のお{母|かあ}さん - explicit "in-law's mother"

CONTEXT:
{義母|ぎぼ} is more commonly used in:
・Written documents
・Speaking about (not to) one's mother-in-law
・Formal contexts

FAMILY TERMS WITH {義|ぎ}:
・{義父|ぎふ} - father-in-law
・{義兄|ぎけい} - brother-in-law (older)
・{義弟|ぎてい} - brother-in-law (younger)
・{義姉|ぎし} - sister-in-law (older)
・{義妹|ぎまい} - sister-in-law (younger)
・{義理|ぎり}の{息子|むすこ} - son-in-law
・{義理|ぎり}の{娘|むすめ} - daughter-in-law

NUANCE:
The {義|ぎ} prefix indicates a family relationship through marriage rather than blood.
